facts.big: is/are included · is/are sold · How much
facts.label: Passivo presente e how much
facts.sub: Use is/are + particípio para dizer o que acontece: Tax is included. Chocolate is sold here. Pergunte preços com How much is it?

facts.label: Incluído
facts.sub: Use is/are included para dizer o que está no preço: Tax is included. The bag is not included. Para perguntar, diga Is the bag included? A resposta é Yes, it is ou No, it isn’t.

facts.label: Quanto
facts.sub: Para perguntar o preço, diga How much is it? ou How much is that chocolate? Em inglês britânico, as respostas usam pounds e pence: two pounds, five pence.
